svg.text: UML component diagram. Fill colour is the component's role; connector notation is defined in the legend.
the only env and YAML reader;
scenario data — a variant is a file,
B's static pose, C closing along x at
the cpm_encode client; restarts on death
the only socket holder; one datagram out
the same JSONL protocol, so the suite
runs with no C++ toolchain and can
inject errors and a deliberate death
stdio: one CpmContent JSON in, one base64 payload out
The wire is unidirectional: nothing on this node binds a listening port.
Dashed open arrow — a «use» dependency between components.
Solid triangle — realization: the component implements the interface above it.
A rounded outer frame is a «node» of the R5 blueprint; a grey frame is outside this node.
A dashed component stands in for another node's real image during a test.
